S.1. Special Branch
REPORT
File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY S. B. D. 8644
Date December 1, 19 38.

Subject J.W.E. Barrett (British) applicant for position in Revenue Department
of S.M.C.

Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C. Crawford D.S.I.

Reference the attached memo dated 29.11.38, addressed
to D.C.(Special Branch) by the Deputy Treasurer-Revenue,
S.M.C. requesting any information which may be available
as to the suitability of Mr. J.W.E. Barrett, ex-Probationary
Sergeant, S.M.P., for employment in the Revenue Department
of the S.M.C. enquiries reveal the following: -

Barrett, who was born at Clackmannan, Scotland in
1907, for some time served in the Scots Guards. He joined
the S.M.P. on September 6th, 1927 and resigned on December
10th, 1932. A copy of his Discharge Certificate is attached
hereto, which covers the period of his service with the
S.M.P.

After leaving the Police, Barrett entered the employ-
ment of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co. Ltd. and was employed in
the Thorburn Road Factory belonging to said Company, from
June 1935 to December 1935, when his services terminated
due to a reduction of the staff. His services with the
Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co. Ltd. were, according to his superiors,
entirely satisfactory. His next period of employment was
as a salesman of the Ewo Brewery Sales Dept., Jardine,
Matheson & Co., from September 1936 to July 1937, when his
services were terminated due to his having got in debt to
one or two customers of the last mentioned Company, as a
result of his signing chits which he was unable to pay.
His superiors in Ewo Brewery Sales Department speak highly
of Barrett's work with the company which, except for the
matter of/debts mentioned above, was beyond reproach.

报告
档案号：警务处特别股登记册 S. B. D. 8644
日期：1938年12月1日。

事由：J.W.E. Barrett（英国人），申请工部局税务处职位

制作人：副督察长 Logan    转呈人：C. Crawford 副督察长

参照附上的备忘录，日期为1938年11月29日，由工部局助理司库兼税务司致警务处副处长（特别股），要求提供关于前上海公共租界工部局警务处试用巡佐 J.W.E. Barrett 先生是否适合受雇于工部局税务处的任何现有信息。经查询，情况如下：-

Barrett 于1907年出生于苏格兰克拉卡曼南（Clackmannan），曾在苏格兰近卫军服役一段时间。他于1927年9月6日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处，并于1932年12月10日辞职。随函附上其退伍证明书副本，涵盖其在上海公共租界工部局警务处的服役期间。

离开警队后，Barrett 受雇于颐中烟草股份有限公司（Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co. Ltd.），并在该公司所属的韬宾路（Thorburn Road）工厂工作，从1935年6月至1935年12月，后因裁员而终止雇佣关系。据其上司称，他在颐中烟草股份有限公司的服务完全令人满意。他的下一段工作经历是1936年9月至1937年7月在怡和洋行（Jardine, Matheson & Co.）旗下的怡和啤酒销售部担任推销员，后因他签署了一些无力支付的签单，欠下该最后一家公司的一两名客户的债务，导致雇佣关系终止。怡和啤酒销售部的上司对 Barrett 在公司的工作评价很高，除了上述债务问题外，其表现无可指责。

    Regarding the signing of chits, it was stated by
one of his superiors that though the company could not
condone his action, there was some excuse for it, as his
work involved the visiting of numerous Bars, Hotels, etc.,
in the course of the day, to which he was endeavouring
to sell beer and that many of his customers expected him to
buy them drinks. Also that the buying of drinks was to
some extent necessary in order to promote sales. After
the outbreak of local Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1937,
Barrett joined the S.M.P. (Specials). On 1.4.38, he was
given a position as a temporary employee of the Revenue
Department, S.M.C., for the collection of Revenue on The
Bund, and is still employed in this capacity.
    Supt. Merritt, attached to S.M.P. (Specials)
Headquarters, who was interviewed on 30.11.38, stated that
in his opinion Barrett is diligent and trustworthy.
Members of the S.M.P. attached to Central Station, whose
duties are connected with The Bund Jetties, who have been
in daily contact with Barrett, speak highly of his attention
to his duties and alertness.
    It would appear therefore that Barrett has been
on the whole assiduous in his efforts to establish himself
and that if appointed to a position in the Revenue Dept.
he will give satisfaction to his employers.

    关于签署签单一事，他的一位上司表示，虽然公司不能宽恕其行为，但也情有可原，因为他的工作涉及白天走访众多酒吧、旅馆等，试图向其推销啤酒，而且许多客户期望他请客喝酒。此外，为了促进销售，请客喝酒在某种程度上也是必要的。1937年中日局部敌对行动爆发后，Barrett 加入了上海公共租界工部局警务处（后备队）。1938年4月1日，他被任命为工部局税务处的临时雇员，负责在外滩征收税款，目前仍以此身份受雇。
    隶属于上海公共租界工部局警务处（后备队）总部的梅里特（Merritt）警司于1938年11月30日接受问询时表示，他认为 Barrett 勤奋且值得信赖。隶属于中央捕房、职责与外滩码头有关的上海公共租界工部局警务处成员，因每日与 Barrett 接触，对其尽职尽责和警觉性评价很高。
    因此，Barrett 似乎在努力立足方面总体上是勤勉的，如果被任命为税务处的职位，他将令雇主满意。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date November 24, 1938.
Subject H.V. ENBERG - Application for employment in Revenue Department
of S.M.C.
Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. G__d__

Harry Verne Enberg, Jewish, applicant for employment
in the Revenue Department of S.M.C., was born in Lodz,
Poland. (According to his S.V.C. record and a certificate
issued by the Shanghai Jewish Communal Association, the
date of his birth is given as 14 March, 1910, but Mr.
Enberg claims that this is inaccurate and should be 8 March,
1912.) He is not in possession of a passport and though
described in various documents as an American, has no legal
claim to that, or any other, nationality.

At the age of four years his father died and a year
later Enberg was brought to China by his mother, who later
married an American and was subsequently deserted by him.
Mrs. Enberg died in 1927.

Enberg received his education in Tientsin and after
leaving school found employment as a proof reader for the
North China Star, on the staff of which paper he remained
until 1927. Leaving Tientsin he came to Shanghai and was
employed as a salesman by the Leather Products Manufacturing
Company. From the latter company he went to the American
Asiatic Trading Company as a store-keeper and remained at
this post until the end of 1934. From 1934 until early in
1936, and intermittently after that date until the present
time, Enberg was employed by Dr. William Chow (周志禮)
of the Kai Mai Hospital, in a liaison capacity between the
doctor and his Russian clients.

In 1936 he returned to Tientsin and found employment
with the Oriental Trading & Engineering Company (File D.4311).
He remained in the shipping department of this firm for two
months and then returned to Shanghai.

报告
日期：1938年11月24日。
事由：H.V. ENBERG - 申请在工部局税务处任职
制作人：侦探警长 Henchman    转呈人：C. G__d__

Harry Verne Enberg，犹太人，申请在工部局税务处任职，出生于波兰罗兹（Lodz）。（根据其在上海万国商团（S.V.C.）的记录以及上海犹太社团协会出具的证明，其出生日期记载为1910年3月14日，但 Enberg 先生声称这不准确，应为1912年3月8日。）他没有护照，虽然在各种文件中被描述为美国人，但他没有合法的权利主张美国国籍或其他任何国籍。

四岁时父亲去世，一年后 Enberg 被母亲带到中国，母亲后来嫁给一名美国人，随后被其抛弃。Enberg 夫人于1927年去世。

Enberg 在天津接受教育，毕业后在《华北星报》（North China Star）担任校对员，一直在该报社工作至1927年。离开天津后，他来到上海，受雇于皮革制品制造公司担任推销员。之后他从该公司转到美亚贸易公司（American Asiatic Trading Company）担任仓库管理员，并在此职位上工作至1934年底。从1934年到1936年初，以及此后断断续续至今，Enberg 受雇于凯迈医院（Kai Mai Hospital）的周志禮（Dr. William Chow）医生，担任医生与其俄国客户之间的联络人。

1936年，他回到天津，在东方贸易工程公司（Oriental Trading & Engineering Company）（档案 D.4311）找到工作。他在该公司的航运部工作了两个月，然后返回上海。

Since 1936 Enberg has been employed successively by
the General Electric Co., Messrs. Scharpf Guenter &Co., and
the purchasing and disbursing office of the U.S. Navy; from
all these concerns he bears excellent references. He has
been a member of the S.V.C. for ten years and now holds the
rank of Company Sergeant Major in the Jewish Company.

General enquiries show that Enberg while not considered
to be particularly useful if placed in an executive or
supervisory capacity, is, nevertheless, completely
trustworthy and a very hard worker. His records, both
S.V.C. and from firms who have employed him, are good and
there is nothing to his detriment in Police files. He
appears to be reasonably well educated, speaks English,
Russian, Chinese (both Northern and Local), German, and
would seem to be quite a satisfactory candidate for the
Revenue Department of the S.M.C.

自1936年以来，Enberg 先后受雇于通用电气公司（General Electric Co.）、Scharpf Guenter & Co. 商行以及美国海军采购与支付办公室；所有这些机构都为他提供了极好的推荐信。他加入上海万国商团（S.V.C.）已有十年，目前在犹太连担任连队军士长。

一般调查显示，Enberg 虽然被认为如果担任行政或监督职务并非特别有用，但他完全值得信赖，且工作非常努力。他的记录，无论是上海万国商团的还是曾雇用他的公司的，都很好，警方档案中没有任何对他不利的记录。他似乎受过良好的教育，会说英语、俄语、中文（北方话和本地话）、德语，似乎是工部局税务处相当合适的候选人。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch - S.I. Station, 8644
REPORT
Date November 14, 1938.
Subject William HALLETT - Applicant for employment in the Revenue
Department, Shanghai Municipal Council.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Crawford

William HALLETT, American, born in Boston, Mass.
39 years ago, was honourably discharged from the United
States Navy on July 7, 1933 after sixteen years service.
He is still on the Fleet Reserve and is liable to be
called up for active service at any time conditions
warrant. He is in receipt of a retaining fee of
Gold $41.80 per month whilst on the reserve. He finished
his navy career holding the rank of Machinist's Mate 2nd.
Class.
He is a widower, his Chinese wife having died a
few years ago. He has one son by this marriage.
He is in possession of documents from various
Naval officers and authorities which state that he is
a hardworking and reliable type of individual. Nothing
can be learned to his detriment locally from a criminal
point of view although certain members of the United States
Naval Purchasing Office, 51 Canton Road, where, once
monthly Hallett goes to draw his pension, are of the
opinion that the applicant is low in intelligence and
a very heavy drinker and not fitted for a post that
requires long hours and abstention from liquor. Efforts
made to confirm this version from other independent sources,
however, have failed.
In 1934 Hallett registered with the Salvation Army
Employment Centre but although this organization was
unable to secure for him a position he is well spoken of
by the staff. Similar recommendations have been voiced
by other persons who have been acquainted with him for
a number of years.
D.C. (Special Branch).
D. S. Pitts

制作人：侦探警长 Pitts。转呈人：C. Crawford

William HALLETT，美国人，39年前出生于马萨诸塞州波士顿，在美国海军服役十六年后，于1933年7月7日光荣退伍。他仍在舰队预备役名单上，一旦条件允许，随时可能被征召服现役。在预备役期间，他每月领取41.80金元的保留费。他在海军生涯结束时军衔为二级机械师助手（Machinist's Mate 2nd Class）。
他是鳏夫，其中国妻子几年前去世。这段婚姻育有一子。
他持有来自多位海军军官和当局的文件，表明他是一个勤奋可靠的人。从刑事角度来看，本地查不到任何对他不利的记录，尽管广东路51号美国海军采购办公室的某些成员（Hallett 每月去那里领取养老金一次）认为申请人智力低下，酗酒严重，不适合需要长时间工作和戒酒的职位。然而，试图从其他独立来源证实这一说法的努力均告失败。
1934年，Hallett 在救世军就业中心登记，虽然该组织未能为他找到职位，但该中心工作人员对他评价很好。其他认识他多年的人也表达了类似的推荐意见。
副处长（特别股）。

Harry Verne Enberg, Jewish, applicant for employment 
in the Revenue Department of 5.M.C., was born in Lodz, 
Poland. (According to his S.V.C. record and a certificate 
issued by the Shanghai Jewish Communal association, the 
date of his birth is given as 14 March, 1910, but Mr. 
Enberg claims that thie is inaccurate and should be 8 March, 
1912.) He is not in possession of a passport and though 
described in various documents as an american, has no iegal 
claim to that, or any other, nationality. 

At the age of four years his father died and a year 
later Enberg was brought to China by his mother, who later 
married an 4merican and was subsequently deserted by him. 
Mrs. Enberg died in 1927. 

Enberg received his education in tientsin and after 
leaving school found employment as a proof reader for the 
North China Staf®,on the staff of which paper he remained 
until 1927. Leaving Tientsin he came to Shanghai and was 
employed as a salesman by the Leather Products Manufacturing 
Company. rom the latter company he went to the «merican 
Asiatic Trading Company as a store-keeper and remained at 
this post until the end of 1934. From 1934 until early in 
1956, and intermittently after that date until the present 
time, Enberg was employed by Dr. William chow (fj & ## ) 
of the Kai Mai Hospitel, in a liaison capacity between the 
aoctor and his Russian clients. 

In 1956 he returned to Tientsin and found employment 
with the Oriental Trading & Engineering Company (File D.43511). 
He remained in the shipping department of this firm for two 
months and then returned to shanghai.
